transcript.answer: There were two causes, one after the other. Before subsystem v0.11.2, the ai-agent-subsystem only rendered a recipe's `mcp_servers` for Claude. gemini-cli has no MCP flag and reads its servers from settings files, so Gemini pods got no Lore MCP at all. This includes every code review after reviews moved to Gemini 3.1 Pro. v0.11.2 (lore #2133, subsystem #240) wrote the servers to a system-scope settings file named by GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH. gemini-cli refuses a system settings file unless its parent directory is root-owned, and the pod runs as uid 1000. It printed 'Security Warning: Skipping system settings file' and started with 'init … (0 tools)'. The fix came in v0.11.3 (subsystem #246, lore #2144), deployed 2026-09-23. It merges the servers into the user settings file /agent/.gemini/settings.json instead, and a run then made mcp_lore_* calls.

judgements.reason: The answer states that v0.11.2 wrote MCP servers to a system-scope settings file, which gemini-cli refused because the pod runs as uid 1000, and that v0.11.3 moved them to /agent/.gemini/settings.json; the extra pre-v0.11.2 detail does not contradict the gold.
